title: I Let My Neighbor Keep the Stand Mixer Until the Quiet Portal Logged It

parts.text: I left the stand mixer on their stoop at 7:18 p.m. with the borrow card taped to the bowl. The card said BACK BY SUNDAY. It was Wednesday. I was twenty-nine, renter, standing in a hallway that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the card, the stoop, and the mixer serial. Then I opened the quiet portal. The building pinged a borrow that had aged four days. They returned the mixer with the paddle still in the bowl. I keep the portal still. The hallway finally knows a Sunday from a Wednesday.
